issues.title: WIN-011: quote-mining in self-retraction lead -- Yang & Wang 2002 does NOT retract; it relocates null to eclipse proper while reaffirming contact-phase valleys
issues.description: EXP-590 reframe rests on "The dome's own source withdrew the number" and "self-retraction" (finding, detail_verdict_text, tldr_evidence, tldr_verdict). This is false: Yang & Wang 2002 abstract concludes "no significant anomaly during the very solar eclipse was found" (true) BUT the SAME abstract's next two sentences reaffirm contact-phase valleys (~6-7 uGal at first and last contact). Yang & Wang relocated the null to eclipse window proper -- they did NOT retract the dataset. A dome defender who reads the publicly-visible abstract destroys our lead in one screenshot. The intermittency-neutralization paragraph collapses with the retraction premise. Stronger replacement: dome claims -6.5 uGal AT ECLIPSE MAXIMUM (raw-text/02-wins.txt:84); both Wang 2000 and Yang & Wang 2002 report null at maximum; surviving contact-phase valleys have conventional explanation (Van Flandern & Yang 2003, Phys. Rev. D 67, 022002). See WIN-011.c6 hole 1 for full reconstruction.
